phase: slices A, B1, B2, C pushed (677c45f; 1d10877 + a1cf29f; 2e2461d; fca0c25); clippy clean for lane files in pigment, folio, render-cpu, render-gpu, harness (viewer); 31 focused tests green plus regressions

commits.subject: pigment (SMB-PS-SELECT-LIQUIFY-2 slice A): magnetic lasso, refinement brushes, turbulence, mesh clone
folio (SMB-PS-SELECT-LIQUIFY-2 slice B1): smart filter stack record on raster layer records
folio tests (SMB-PS-SELECT-LIQUIFY-2 slice B1): fixture tile sizes as f64 so the record round-trips to equal JSON
pigment + render-cpu + render-gpu (SMB-PS-SELECT-LIQUIFY-2 slice B2): smart filter stacks in the render plan
harness (SMB-PS-SELECT-LIQUIFY-2 slice C): viewer buttons and canvas gestures for wand, quick select, magnetic lasso, liquify; sample merged

capabilities_done: slice A select_tools::magnetic: LiveWire (Mortensen-Barrett 1995 local cost 0.43 fZ + 0.43 fG + 0.14 fD, Sobel max-channel gradient, Laplacian zero crossings, 8-connected Dijkstra path, snap(width, contrast)), magnetic_lasso(trace, MagneticOptions{width, contrast, frequency, sample_merged, margin_px})

slice A select_tools::refine_brush: RefineState{selection, unknown/foreground/background/feather marks} + apply_brush(RefineBrush{samples, diameter, hardness, mode RefineEdge|AddToSelection|SubtractFromSelection|Matte|Foreground|Background|Feather, feather_px}) via the brush engine; render through refine::refine_with_marks(TrimapMarks)
slice A liquify: LiquifyTool::Turbulence{seed}, LiquifyTool::MeshClone{dx, dy}; LiquifyTool is PartialEq (no longer Eq: f64 fields)

slice B1 folio: StudioRasterLayerRecord.smart_filters: Option<StudioSmartFilterStack{enabled, stack_mask: Option<StudioMask>, filters: [StudioSmartFilter{instance_id, enabled, opacity percent, mask: Option<StudioMask>, params: gaussian_blur|unsharp_mask|high_pass|median|add_noise|liquify{mesh: StudioLiquifyMesh, resample}}]}> (serde default + skip when absent: earlier record sets byte-identical); validated in validate_raster_records (cap 16, key ids unique, opacity percent, finite non-negative params, mask tiles of this layer with unique keys and coverage formats, mesh grid/length/finite/freeze range, mesh bomb -> BudgetExceeded before per-vertex walk; entries + vertices against Budget.nodes)

slice B2 pigment: LayerExtension.smart_filters: Option<smart_filter::SmartFilterOp{entries: [SmartFilterEntryOp{filter: StackFilter, enabled, opacity, mask: Option<MaskInput>}], stack_mask: Option<MaskInput>}> (serde-skipped when None: digests unchanged), ExtOperator::SmartFilter key smart_filter_stack class Approximate, PlanError::SmartFilterParameter / SmartFilterCombination, envelope validation, SmartFilterOp::check / to_stack / from_record (Folio record -> envelope op)

slice B2 render-cpu: plan_sink/smart_filter.rs resolves mask sources and runs pigment SmartFilterStack::render once over the layer content inside the extent before the first chunk (extra node, like keys); planes charged before any sink call; smart_filter_nested refusal; extension_exactness SmartFilter = intrinsic
slice B2 render-gpu: SmartFilter falls to Unsupported, shared admission refuses before device work or sink calls (typed refusal, test without adapter)

slice C harness: Tool::MagicWand / QuickSelect / MagneticLasso / Liquify buttons (tool.magic_wand, tool.quick_selection, tool.magnetic_lasso, tool.liquify), canvas wand click + drag gestures via Viewer::ps_click / ps_gesture, option row ps.* ids (tolerance, contiguous, sample merged, quick size, edge width, liquify tool / size / pressure), EditState.ps PsSettings + Viewer::set_ps, sample merged = rendered composite frame (wand, quick select, magnetic lasso), Viewer::select_quick_merged, Viewer::select_magnetic

tests.argv: pigment --test select_liquify_2 (5); folio --test smart_filter_records (2) + raster_records_contract (3, regression); render-cpu --test cpu_smart_filter (2) + cpu_keying/cpu_filters/cpu_content_aware (9, regression); render-gpu --test gpu_smart_filter (1); pigment --test plan_extensions --test smart_filter --test plan_limits (13, regression) + select_refine/liquify/smart_filter (14, regression); harness --features viewer --test viewer_select_liquify_2 (3) + viewer_select_liquify (3) + viewer_edit (3)

next: validator round on 677c45f..fca0c25 (lane commits listed); composite lowering of the Folio smart_filters record into LayerExtension.smart_filters is the remaining end-to-end link (composite owner; SmartFilterOp::from_record is ready)

notes.spec_basis: STU-RAS-018 row 'Magnetic lasso | Edge-snapping selection with width, contrast, and frequency controls.'; STU-RAS-122 'brush set with the modes refine_edge, add_to_selection, subtract_from_selection, plus a matte/foreground/background mode set and a feather mode, each driven by the one brush engine of §6'; STU-RAS-140 row 'Liquify | Localized mesh push-forward, push-left, twirl, pinch, punch, turbulence, mesh-clone, and reconstruct brushes, with freeze/thaw masking.'; STU-RAS-037 'StudioLiveFilter is the single canonical live-filter primitive: a re-editable, maskable filter'; STU-FX-011a 'a filter on any layer is already the non-destructive stack'; STU-FX-024 'Its distortion is stored as a re-editable mesh on the stack entry'; STU-RAS-119 sample_all_layers
notes.measured_bounds: magnetic lasso IoU vs a 24 px square 0.9366 (asserted >= 0.9); live wire on a vertical edge stays on columns 31..=32; refine-edge brush row 8 max |alpha - truth| 0.0086 (asserted < 0.05); turbulence max displacement 3.2624 px (analytic bound 6.7882); render-cpu smart stack (blur with u8 mask, liquify at opacity 0.6, disabled median, noise, inverted stack mask) bit-identical to the direct pigment call for chunk/thread (1,1) (3,1) (5,4) (64,1) (4,8) (7,2); peak working bytes 26712 with the stack vs 3200 plain, refused BudgetExceeded at the plain peak; viewer: merged wand 4 px off the square (the 4 inner AA corners), viewer magnetic lasso 43 px off (asserted <= 160), quick-select gesture 4 px off
notes.own_failures: slice B1 test: first byte-identity check compared serde_json::Value map order (alphabetical) with struct order - test fixed; second run: fixture lengths 64 vs 64.0 after round trip - fixture fixed; both via retry-guard route (a): fix committed (1d10877, a1cf29f), rerun green. slice C: lane-1 test asserted the sample_merged refusal that this lane implements; assertion replaced in fca0c25 (V4-14: viewer_select_liquify.rs of the READY lane SMB-PS-SELECT-LIQUIFY changed, listed here as part of this lane's claim). No gameplan step added.
notes.shared_file_hunks: folio lib.rs/raster.rs, pigment render_plan.rs/extensions.rs, render-cpu plan_sink.rs/extended.rs, harness edit.rs: only this lane's hunks existed at commit time (pathspec commits). harness view/mod.rs (fca0c25) also held the audio-import lane's uncommitted `pub mod audio_import` lines: committed from a temporary index (HEAD + this lane's hunks), then the real index entries of this lane's paths were reset to the new HEAD (index-only `git reset -- <paths>`, no working-tree change). Pushes also carried other lanes' already-committed local commits (e.g. 19fb4f3).
notes.readings_unverified_d5: magnetic lasso cost details, width/contrast/frequency mapping; refinement brush mode semantics; turbulence noise and mesh clone formula; smart filter stack evaluated over the layer content bounds inside the extent (filter halos beyond the content are clipped), premultiplied mix, normal-only entries; sample merged = the displayed composite in 8-bit sRGB. All Studio readings, Photoshop UNVERIFIED (D5).
notes.gaps: composite does not lower Folio smart_filters into the envelope yet (composite owner; pigment SmartFilterOp::from_record ready); no GPU smart-filter pass (typed refusal); viewer does not persist liquify meshes as smart-filter records; refine-edge brushes have no viewer tool yet; face-aware liquify not implemented
notes.v4: deny(clippy::arithmetic_side_effects) on every new module (pigment magnetic, refine_brush, folio smart_filter, render-cpu plan_sink/smart_filter, harness select_liquify); budgets before allocation (live wire 205 B/px, render-cpu stack planes charged before the first sink call, folio mesh bomb BudgetExceeded); hostile tests in every slice (NaN, out of range, too many entries, mesh bombs, broken meshes, missing mask source, budget one short)
notes.new_edges: none (pigment -> folio, render-cpu -> pigment, harness -> pigment existing); no crates.io dependency
